admission.rule: technical + left centroid + shape vs reflected right (median <=3 mm, extents 0.8-1.25) + no clear one-sided bone contact (<=2.5 mm on one side and >0.5 mm farther and >2.5 mm on the other)
admission.limitation: Native left BodyParts3D 3.0 surfaces reduced to the face budget of the accepted right part. Origins/insertions, attachment areas, fibre directions, part boundaries and pins are not accepted for the left side; card text repeats the verified paired right description. No independent left specimen.
